declaration.preface: Val Organics Private Limited is committed to operating in an environmentally and socially responsible manner. As part of our dedication to sustainability, we have developed a comprehensive Sustainable Procurement Policy. This policy outlines our principles, engagements, and objectives to integrate environmental, social, and ethical considerations into our procurement processes. By prioritizing suppliers with sustainable practices, promoting fair labor conditions, and minimizing environmental impact throughout our supply chain, we aim to contribute positively to our communities and the planet. Our Sustainable Procurement Policy reflects our commitment to responsible business practices and aligns with our core values of integrity, transparency, and accountability.
declaration.declaration: At Val Organics Private Limited, we are committed to conducting procurement activities in a sustainable and responsible manner. We prioritize suppliers who uphold ethical labor practices, minimize environmental impact, and promote social responsibility. Through our Sustainable Procurement Policy, we aim to foster a supply chain that aligns with our commitment to environmental stewardship, social equity, and ethical conduct.
declaration.scope: This Policy is applicable to following sites and all of its employees, workers, contractors, sub-contractors and other stakeholders:

focusAreas: Promote Ethical Practices in Supply Chain
Audit Supplier Compliance with Sustainability Goals
Encourage Supplier Diversity and Fair-Trade Practices
Foster Long-term Partnerships for Sustainable Growth
Promote Local Sourcing and Community Support

Enforce Ecological Standards for Vendors: We partner with vendors who share our commitment to environmental responsibility.
We develop clear criteria for environmentally responsible practices, including energy efficiency, waste reduction, and pollution control.
Promote Ethical Practices in Supply Chai: We uphold ethical labor practices throughout our supply chain, including fair wages, safe working conditions, and adherence to human rights principles.
We integrate labor and human rights considerations into vendor contracts and conduct regular audits to verify compliance.
Audit Supplier Compliance with Sustainab: We establish a comprehensive supplier audit program to assess compliance with our sustainability criteria.
We work collaboratively with suppliers to identify areas for improvement and provide support for achieving sustainability goals.
Encourage Supplier Diversity and Fair-Tr: We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive supplier base, promoting fair trade practices and supporting small and medium-sized enterprises.
We actively seek partnerships with diverse suppliers and explore opportunities to partner with fair trade organizations.
Implement Vendor Risk Management: We proactively identify and mitigate potential environmental, social, and economic risks within our supply chain.
We develop a comprehensive vendor risk management program that considers environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors.
Foster Long-term Partnerships for Sustai: We believe in building long-term, collaborative partnerships with our suppliers to promote mutual sustainability goals.
We establish open communication channels with suppliers, fostering knowledge sharing and joint sustainability initiatives.
Enhance Supply Chain Resilience: We work to ensure the resilience of our supply chain against disruptions caused by environmental, social, or economic factors.
We diversify our supplier base and explore opportunities for near-shoring or local sourcing where feasible.
Promote Local Sourcing and Community Sup: We are committed to supporting local communities by sourcing materials and services locally when possible.
We develop clear criteria for local sourcing and prioritize partnerships with local vendors.
Pursue Collaboration for Environmental I: We believe in working collaboratively with suppliers and industry partners to develop innovative solutions for environmental challenges.
We explore opportunities for joint research and development projects focused on sustainable materials, processes, and technologies.
Sustainable Supplier Certification: Increase sourcing from suppliers holding recognized sustainability certifications (e.g., ISO 14001, FSC, Fair Tra de, SA8000, or equivalent).
Supplier Sustainability Training & Capac: Provide sustainability awareness, ESG training, and capacity-building programs to suppliers to improve environmental, social, and governance performance.
Supplier ESG Assessment Coverage: Assess supplier sustainability performance through ESG questionnaires, audits, and performance reviews.
Supplier ESG Compliance: Strengthen supplier adherence to the Company's Supplier Code of Conduct and ESG requirements.

responsibilities.duty: Lead Policy Development and Implementation: Draft, implement, and maintain the sustainable procurement policy.
Develop Sustainable Sourcing Criteria: Establish clear criteria for environmentally and socially responsible practices for suppliers.
Supplier Selection and Onboarding: Integrate sustainability factors into the supplier selection process and onboard new suppliers with the policy.
Supplier Management and Engagement: Monitor supplier performance against sustainability goals, conduct audits, and provide resources for improvement.
Data Collection and Reporting: Track progress on sustainable procurement goals and report findings to relevant stakeholders.
Develop Sustainability Guidelines: Provide guidance and expertise on integrating sustainability principles into procurement practices.
Collaborate with Procurement: Support the procurement team in developing and implementing sustainable sourcing criteria.
Life Cycle Assessment (LCA): Assist with integrating LCA considerations into product development and procurement decisions.

Review Sustainable Procurement Policy: Review the Sustainable Procurement Policy at least annually, or more frequently as needed, to reflect changes in regulatory requirements, sustainability standards, supply chain risks, stakeholder expectations, and industry best practices.
Provide Leadership and Resources: Allocate resources and champion the importance of sustainable procurement within the organization.
Set Sustainability Goals: Establish overall sustainability goals and align them with procurement objectives.
Integrate sustainability considerations into product design and specifications.
Analyze the cost-benefit of sustainable procurement practices and consider lifecycle costs alongside upfront costs.
Ensure compliance with relevant environmental and labor regulations.
Follow Policy Requirements: Adhere to the Sustainable Procurement Policy and related procedures in all applicable activities.
Support Sustainable Decision-Making: Consider environmental, social, and ethical factors when making procurement-related decisions.
Participate in Training: Attend sustainability and procurement-related training programs as required.
Report Concerns: Raise concerns regarding supplier conduct, environmental performance, labor practices, or policy non-compliance through established reporting channels.
Contribute to Sustainability Objectives: Support the Company's efforts to achieve its sustainable procurement goals and targets.

policy.monitoring:
Sustainable procurement performance shall be evaluated against established objectives, targets, supplier performance indicators, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

The implementation of the Policy and progress toward achieving sustainable procurement commitments shall be assessed to identify opportunities for improvement.

Supplier assessment results, audit findings, risk evaluations, and procurement data shall be reviewed to monitor the effectiveness of responsible sourcing practices.
policy.reviewMechanism:
To ensure the effectiveness and continuous improvement of Val Organics Pvt. Ltd.'s Sustainable Procurement Policy, the following review mechanism shall be implemented:

The Sustainability Officer shall review the Policy at least annually, or more frequently if significant changes occur in regulatory requirements, sustainability standards, supply chain risks, business operations, or stakeholder expectations.

Feedback from relevant stakeholders, including employees, suppliers, customers, investors, and regulatory bodies, shall be considered during the review process.

Based on the review findings, necessary updates, corrective actions, and enhancements shall be recommended to strengthen sustainable procurement practices and align with evolving industry standards and best practices.

Any revisions to the Policy shall be subject to approval by the CEO of Val Organics Pvt. Ltd.

The outcomes of the review process and significant policy updates shall be communicated to relevant stakeholders, as appropriate.

This review mechanism will help ensure that the Sustainable Procurement Policy remains effective, relevant, and aligned with Val Organics' commitment to responsible sourcing, ethical business conduct, environmental stewardship, and continuous improvement.
